notes.title: New Modes Update: Endless Challenge & Zen Mode
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32077085/9be178f37fb04acd45cbc0e550767249122a559a.jpg[/img]

We have just launched a new ‘Endless Challenge Mode’ and ‘Zen mode’ update!

In the ‘Endless Challenge’ mode, you will fight to reach the top of the online leaderboards; taking on 3 different challenges, each with 2 levels of difficulty. The challenges you can compete in are: 

[list]
[*]Speed: complete as many tickets as you can within 10 minutes. 
[*]Time: earn a target amount of money as fast as possible by completing tickets. 
[*]Perfection: respond to as many customers as you can but don’t make any mistakes.. One misstep and your game is over!
[/list]

Feeling stressed out or overwhelmed? In Zen mode, you can complete tickets for as long as you wish without the risk of losing your job. 

Both modes are now available and are integrated seamlessly with the original version of the game. You can access the new modes in two ways:

[olist]
[*]Through completing the game! By reaching any of the game's multiple main endings, the modes are automatically unlocked. Players who have already completed the game will see these modes unlocked immediately.
[*]When booting the game, click on the BIOS option to manually activate the new modes. You may also uncover additional secrets in this menu!
[/olist]

Play it cool or amp up the competition- the choice is yours!

[b]Tech Support: Error Unknown[/b] has also been shortlisted as a finalist at Momocon 2019, and our Lead Developer Kevin Giguère will be attending the event from May 23rd to 26th in Atlanta, Georgia. Stop by booth 1031 and find out if YOU are the best tech support specialist out there.

notes.title: Update V1.006 out now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've been reading all of your comments, praise, criticisms and bug reports, and I want to thank you for your passion concerning the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32077085/275814fd922a05f638b5ab02521605ba3d16a46d.png[/img]

We've been hard at work producing a new patch which should cover a lot of issues you guys have been having with the game, including for our international audience in Germany and China. Please continue posting your issues in the forums and we'll continue to update the game accordingly.

Check out the full forum post, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/781480/discussions/0/1836811737974736997/]here![/url]

[b]Changelog for v 1.006:[/b]
[list]
[*]Difficulty icons now representative of the difficulty when mouse over 
[*]Conway Domain email no longer appears multiple times (may only work on new games) 
[*]Brother now has a proper reply about warranty on day 3 
[*]Bora now properly replies when impatient on day 4 
[*]Better feedback when the player fails a VIP warranty
[*]Spence's Oasis now properly updates when purchasing in categories 
[*]Customer notes now marked as "used" when the upgrade is bought
[*]Some typos resolved 
[*][spoiler]In cat mode, Kamala now properly displays when a player fails a ticket [/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Brother ending achievement properly triggers now [/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Kamala no longer fires you if you forward the Indigo chat logs on day 9 [/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]German specific[/b]
[list]
[*]German title for the security code on Day 5 now displays properly 
[*]Updated text fields to make text fits better on screen
[/list]

[b]Chinese specific[/b]
[list]
[*]Chinese Quasar website displays better

[/list]

notes.title: Tech Support: Error Unknown Release Date Leaked
notes.notes:
We confirm that the release date leaked by Indigo is correct. [b]Tech Support: Error Unknown[/b] will be launching for PC, Mac and Linux on February 27th! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32077085/275814fd922a05f638b5ab02521605ba3d16a46d.png[/img]

[b]Tech Support: Error Unknown[/b] casts players as new-starters in the IT department of multinational corporation Quasar Telecommunications, which, you soon discover, does not appear to be it what it seems. From the Spectrum OS virtual desktop interface, you’ll chat with customers and colleagues through an organic procedural dialogue system, solving puzzles and making discoveries and decisions that radically affect the eventual outcome. Will you serve the company, or sabotage it from within?

Every choice matters.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O3--G3LVBEU
Want to get a taste of what it's like to work for Quasar? You can now download & play the demo here on Steam.

Join the Launch Day Live Stream through the store page and don't forget to wishlist the game so you'll be notified when it releases! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781480/Tech_Support_Error_Unknown/
